articles.title: Australia’s Coalition pledges to scrap Temporary Graduate visas, cut student numbers
articles.summary: The Coalition has pledged to abolish Temporary Graduate visas if elected as part of a broader migration plan. It also plans to reduce annual international student commencements to 240,000.
articles.insight:
Australia’s proposed Temporary Graduate visa abolition and student cap may indirectly influence global student decision-making, as prospective applicants from overlapping source markets reassess study destinations amid perceived reduced post-study work opportunities—though actual demand shifts will depend on policy implementation and competing countries’ responses.  
Admissions teams should monitor Australian enrolment data, visa refusal trends, and sentiment shifts in key feeder countries like India and China, while reviewing their own post-study work offerings and articulation pathways to strengthen value propositions amid growing destination competition.
